project.name: Multi-Claud
project.description: CLI tool that orchestrates multiple Claude Code sessions working on the same project in parallel, with a web-based kanban dashboard

components.name: CLI Interface
components.description: Typer-based command-line interface. Entry point for all user commands: init, plan, start, status, stop, dashboard, merge.
components.notes: Installed as 'multi-claud' console script via pyproject.toml

components.name: State Manager
components.description: Core state management. Pydantic data models for packets, workers, risks. JSON file read/write with filelock for safe concurrent access.
components.notes: Foundation — everything else depends on this. State file lives at .multi-claud/state.json in target projects.

components.name: Orchestrator
components.description: Uses Claude Agent SDK to run an orchestrator Claude session that creates build plans, assigns packets to workers, and manages the overall workflow.
components.notes: Uses claude-agent-sdk to programmatically control a Claude Opus session

components.name: Worker Manager
components.description: Launches and monitors Claude Code CLI sessions in headless mode. Each worker runs in an isolated git worktree. Manages worker lifecycle (start, monitor, complete, fail, cleanup).
components.notes: Workers are Claude Code subprocesses launched with: claude -p <prompt> --worktree <name> --output-format stream-json

components.name: Risk Detection Engine
components.description: Monitors for risks across parallel workers: file conflicts between worktrees, duplicate effort, unwired code, dependency violations, stale workers.
components.notes: Runs continuously while workers are active. Critical risks pause the affected worker.

components.name: Dashboard Server
components.description: FastAPI web server that serves the kanban dashboard and streams state updates via Server-Sent Events (SSE).

components.name: Dashboard UI
components.description: Web-based kanban board. Dark theme, real-time updates via SSE, SortableJS for drag-and-drop. Shows packet status, worker assignments, and risk alerts.
components.notes: Single HTML file with embedded CSS and JS. No build step. Uses SortableJS from CDN.

components.name: Orchestrator Prompt Template
components.description: System prompt template given to the orchestrator Claude session. Instructs it on how to analyze a project and generate a build plan.

components.name: Worker Prompt Template
components.description: System prompt template given to each worker Claude session. Includes documentation requirements, progress reporting, and scope constraints.

dataFlows.name: CLI reads/writes state
dataFlows.description: CLI commands read and write the project state file

dataFlows.name: Orchestrator writes plan to state
dataFlows.description: Orchestrator generates packets and writes them to the state file

dataFlows.name: Workers report progress to state
dataFlows.description: Worker manager updates worker status, packet progress, and files touched in the state file

dataFlows.name: Risk detector writes alerts to state
dataFlows.description: Risk detector writes risk alerts to the state file when problems are detected

dataFlows.name: Dashboard server reads state
dataFlows.description: Dashboard server watches the state file for changes and streams updates via SSE
dataFlows.notes: Uses watchfiles to detect state file changes

dataFlows.name: Server streams to dashboard
dataFlows.description: FastAPI streams state updates to the browser via Server-Sent Events

dataFlows.name: Orchestrator assigns work to workers
dataFlows.description: Orchestrator decides which packets to assign and tells the worker manager to launch sessions

dataFlows.name: Risk detector pauses workers
dataFlows.description: When a critical risk is detected, the risk detector can pause the affected worker
dataFlows.notes: Only for critical risks. Info/warning risks are just logged.

externalServices.name: Claude Agent SDK
externalServices.purpose: Programmatically run the orchestrator Claude session that creates build plans and manages workflow

externalServices.name: Claude Code CLI
externalServices.purpose: Worker sessions are Claude Code CLI processes running in headless mode with --worktree isolation

dataStorage: JSON state file (.multi-claud/state.json in target project)
infrastructure.hosting: local (CLI tool runs on user's machine)
infrastructure.notes: Dashboard runs on localhost:8420. No cloud infrastructure needed.

changelog.description: Initial architecture — project scaffolded with all planned components
